name: Yumesaki Haruki
source:
The protagonist of the story who goes to an average university.

Although he pretends to be upbeat, the truth is that he's timid and barely has friends. After losing motivation to go to college, he stops going instead of simply going back and forth between home and the hospital to visit his sister, Anzu.

[Taken from [url=https://sekaiproject.com/products/a-butterfly-in-the-district-of-dreams/]Sekai Project[/url]]
